info.title: My Marriage API
info.description: REST API for the My Marriage wedding planning platform.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR or OWNER_ACTIVE_LIMIT.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Safe to show; never contains internals.

details.description: Extra context that depends on the code. A VALIDATION_ERROR raised by a request body lists the invalid fields; other codes may send an object.

status.description: Always "ok": a failed check is a 503 in the standard error envelope instead.

checks.description: The dependencies that were checked and are reachable. Empty for the liveness probe.

emailVerified.description: False until the link in the verification email is used; most features wait for it.

email.description: Sign-in address. A verification email is sent here.

password.description: At least 10 characters. Common and easily guessed passwords are refused.

displayName.description: The name your partner and family see.

token.description: The secret from the verification link (the part after `#token=`).

email.description: The address to send a new verification link to, if it has an unverified account.
Where to send the reset link, if the address has an account.

token.description: The secret from the reset link (the part after `#token=`).

password.description: The new password: at least 10 characters, not easily guessed.

weddingDate.description: The wedding day (`YYYY-MM-DD`); missing until known.

role.description: The signed-in user's role in this wedding.

slug.description: Address of the public website, once published. Chosen by the server.

state.description: An Indian state or union territory, or "Outside India".

weddingDate.description: The wedding day, if already known.

userId.description: User ID; what a task's `assigneeId` names.

slug.description:
A new web address for the wedding website (decision 0017). The old one
stays reserved for this wedding and redirects to the new one.

weddingDate.description: The wedding day; `null` removes it. A new date must not be in the past.

emailStatus.description:
Whether the latest email went out: `sent` means the provider accepted
it, never that it arrived. `failed` means it could not be sent; resend it.

email.description: The address it was sent to.
Where the invitation is sent; only the account with this address can accept it.

role.description: `owner`: your partner, with the same rights as you.

invitedByName.description: The name of the owner who sent it, if their account still exists.

email.description: Only the account with this address can accept.

invitedByName.description: The name of the owner who sent it, if their account still exists.

startDate.description: The day (`YYYY-MM-DD`) where the ceremony happens; missing until known.

startTime.description: The start time (`HH:mm`) on that day, where it happens; missing until known.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the day and time are read in.

startAt.description: The start as an instant, when both the day and the time are known.

truncated.description: True when the wedding has more events than the list returns.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link, for "Get directions" on the wedding website.

title.description: A preset such as Haldi or Sangeet, or any name.

description.description: Shown to guests once the wedding website is published.
description.example: Turmeric and laughter by the pool.

startDate.description: The day, if known: today or later, where the ceremony happens.

startTime.description: The start time on that day (`HH:mm`, 24-hour); needs `startDate`.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the venue; Asia/Kolkata if left out.

dressCode.description: Suggested attire, shown on the wedding website.

livestreamUrl.description: A YouTube link for the livestream (PRD LIVE-01); only the video is kept.

description.description: Shown to guests once the wedding website is published; `null` removes it.
description.example: Turmeric and laughter by the pool.

startDate.description: The day; `null` removes it and the time with it. A new day must not be in the past.

startTime.description: The start time (`HH:mm`, 24-hour); needs a day. `null` removes it.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the venue. The day and time keep their clock reading in the new zone.

venue.description: Replaces the whole venue; `null` removes it.

livestreamUrl.description: A YouTube link for the livestream; `null` or empty removes it.

state.description: Mark the ceremony completed or cancelled, or scheduled again.

displayName.description: Missing if the account no longer exists.

dueDate.description: The day it is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

dueTime.description: The time it is due (`HH:mm`, India time).

event.description: Its ceremony; missing for a general task.

assignee.description: Missing when unassigned, or when the assignee is no longer on the team.

dueAt.description: The instant it is due, when the time is known.

overdue.description: Open (to do or in progress) and past its due day or time.

truncated.description: True when more tasks match than the list returns.

eventId.description: One of this wedding's events; left out for a general task.

assigneeId.description: An active owner or manager of this wedding; left out for an unassigned task.

dueDate.description: The day it is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`), in India time.

dueTime.description: The time it is due on that day (`HH:mm`, India time); needs `dueDate`.

dueDate.description: `null` removes the due day and the time with it.

dueTime.description: `null` removes the time; needs a day.

events.description: Its ceremonies, in the wedding's order; deleted events are left out.

truncated.description: True when the wedding has more vendors than the list returns.

category.description: Any text; the app suggests common ones, such as Catering (decision 0013).

notes.description: Private notes for the wedding's owners and managers.
notes.example: Confirmed for 3 drones and 4 ground cinematographers.

eventIds.description: This wedding's events the vendor works at; none when left out.

notes.example: Confirmed for 3 drones and 4 ground cinematographers.

eventIds.description: Replaces the linked events; `[]` unlinks them all.

status.description: Unpaid (nothing paid), partially paid, or paid (nothing left).

dueDate.description: The day payment is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

events.description: The ceremonies it is for, in the wedding's order; empty for a general expense.

discountPaise.description: Discounts agreed later, less reversed ones.

extraPaise.description: Extras agreed later, less reversed ones.

finalPaise.description: What is owed in the end: agreed − discounts + extras.

outstandingPaise.description: What is still to pay: final − paid.

overdue.description: Something is still to pay and the due day has passed (India time).

finalPaise.description: What is owed across all expenses: agreed − discounts + extras.

discountPaise.description: Saved by negotiation: discounts across all expenses.

expenses.description: By due day (soonest first, none last), then name.

totals.description: Over the whole wedding, whatever the list shows.

category.description: Any text; the app suggests common ones, such as Catering.

eventIds.description: This wedding's events it is for, if any; repeats ignored.

dueDate.description: The day payment is due (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

notes.description: Private notes for the wedding's owners and managers.
notes.example: Covers 3 drone cinematographers and 4 candid shooters.

displayName.description: Missing if the account no longer exists.

date.description: The day it happened (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

reversalOfId.description: For a reversal: the entry it undid.

reversed.description: For a payment, discount or extra: whether it has been reversed.

eventIds.description: Replaces its events; `[]` makes it a general expense.

notes.example: Covers 3 drone cinematographers and 4 candid shooters.

paidAt.description: The day it was paid (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

date.description: The day it was agreed (`YYYY-MM-DD`, India time).

note.example: Agreed 5% off after the final quote.

noEmail.description: No email address: share their link on WhatsApp instead.

notShared.description: The invitation was never shared: send it first.

remindersOff.description: The guest turned reminder emails off.

recipients.description: Guests who would be emailed: one email each.

emailsLeftToday.description: Emails this wedding can still send today (shared with invitations).

queued.description: Reminder emails queued: one per guest.

attendingCount.description: Attending: 1 to the party size; not attending: 0; maybe: optional; pending: none.

available.description: False once the event was deleted.

cancelled.description: The ceremony was cancelled: its RSVP is closed; the last answer stays.

status.description: none: never created; active: works; revoked: every link was revoked.

secretUrl.description:
The private link; only on a single guest, never in lists. Named so that
request traces mask it: it is a bearer credential.

state.description: What became of the last invitation email; "sent" is never "delivered" (PRD INV-08).

invitations.description: The ceremonies they are invited to, in the wedding's order.

lastEmail.description: Missing if no invitation email was asked for.

lastReminder.description: The last reminder email, by hand or automatic; missing if none.

remindersOff.description: The guest turned reminder emails off from their invitation.

invitedPeople.description: People invited: the sum of those contacts' party sizes.

confirmedPeople.description: People confirmed: attending counts only; maybe is not included.

invitedPeople.description: People invited to at least one ceremony, each counted once across the wedding.

answered.description: Ceremony invitations answered (attending, not attending or maybe).

events.description: Per ceremony, in the wedding's order.

available.description: False once the event was deleted.

cancelled.description: The ceremony was cancelled: its RSVP is closed; the last answer stays.

email.description: Needed only to send the invitation by email.

phone.description: For sharing the link on WhatsApp by hand.

eventIds.description: Ceremonies to invite them to; they can be invited later.

index.description: The row's position in the file's data rows, from 0.

duplicateOf.description: For a possible duplicate: the guest already on the list, or an earlier row.

partySize.description: A whole number of 1 or more; checked per row.

events.description: Ceremony names, matched to the wedding's events ignoring case (decision 0015).

rejected.description: Rows not imported because they have problems.

skipDuplicates.description: Leave out rows that look like guests already on the list.

reissue.description: Revoke the current link and create a new one.

invitationId.description: The event invitation's ID, used to answer it.

cancelled.description: Cancelled: its RSVP is closed; the last answer is shown.

reminderEmails.description:
Reminder emails: `on` or `off` (the guest's choice); missing when the
couple has no email address for them, so there is nothing to turn off.

templateId.description:
The published wedding website's design, which the RSVP page follows;
the standard (Traditional) page while the website isn't published.

slug.description: The wedding website's address, so the website can tell the invitation is its own.

writable.description: False once the wedding is archived: answers can be seen, not changed.

coverUrl.description: The published website's cover photo, served by the API, when there is one.

sendTime.description: Local time in each ceremony's time zone, `HH:mm`.

coverImageId.description: The cover photo's ID, when there is one.

message.description: What is there, or what to do.

publishedTemplateId.description: The template the public sees, while published.

coverUrl.description: The draft's cover photo, for the wedding's members: `/api/v1/weddings/{id}/website/images/{imageId}`.

contentVersion.description: Send it back with the next edit or publication.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: Published, and the draft has changed since.

slug.description: The wedding's web address; the public site is at `/w/{slug}`.

writable.description: False once the wedding is archived: nothing but unpublishing can change.

canUnpublish.description: Whether this member may unpublish now (owners only, once archived).

story.description: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs.

faq.description: The whole list, in order: it replaces the saved one.

contentVersion.description: The version this edit started from; a newer one on the server is a conflict.

livestreamVideoId.description: A YouTube video ID; the site builds the embed and watch links.

slug.description: The current address: different from the one asked for when it moved.

coverUrl.description:
The cover photo, served by the API: the published one for anyone, the
draft's in an organizer's preview. Never a storage address.

story.description: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs.

dateRange.description: The first and last day of the ceremonies with a date, cancelled ones left out.

events.description: In date order, those without a date last.

preview.description: An organizer's preview of the draft, never shown to the public.

available.description: Free for this wedding: unused, or one of its own.

field.description: Dotted path of the invalid property, e.g. `venue.name`.
